verdict.rationale: Granola has an AI Chat that could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only documents Granola's own MCP server, which lets external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT query Granola notes. Chat's actions (email, Slack, Calendar) appear to be built-in integrations, and nothing shows users can plug third-party MCP servers into Granola.
